SELECT c.ticket_comment_id AS ticketCommentId, c.author_employee_id AS authorEmployeeId, c.content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM ticket_comment c JOIN it_ticket t ON t.company_id = c.company_id AND t.it_ticket_id = c.it_ticket_id WHERE ORDER BY c.created_at, c.ticket_comment_id

SELECT h.ticket_history_id AS ticketHistoryId, h.actor_account_id AS actorAccountId, h.before_status AS beforeStatus, h.after_status AS afterStatus, h.before_assignee_id AS beforeAssigneeId, h.after_assignee_id AS afterAssigneeId, h.reason, h.created_at AS createdAt FROM ticket_history h JOIN it_ticket t ON t.company_id = h.company_id AND t.it_ticket_id = h.it_ticket_id WHERE ORDER BY h.created_at, h.ticket_history_id
